criteria.requirement: Add treelib.csvio.read_csv(stream,tree_class=Tree,**tree_kwargs)/write_csv(tree,stream) for an explicit id,parent,tag,data header (exact unique columns/order). IDs and parents are separate from display tags, empty parent denotes root, data is strict JSON text, standard CSV quoting preserves commas/newlines/Unicode. Read valid out-of-order rows through the delivered complete Tree.from_map validation; reject duplicate/empty IDs, wrong field counts/headers, invalid JSON, missing parents and detached cycles instead of losing rows. Write full descendants in current sibling order regardless of expanded, without closing or rewinding caller streams. Tags may be empty without becoming root markers. Preserve original file APIs and document that expanded is a snapshot capability, not a CSV field.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
